label: Speculipastor_bicolor
summary: The magpie starling (Speculipastor bicolor) is a member of the starling family from eastern Africa.

appearance.description: The magpie starling is about 16–19 cm (6.5–7.5 in) in length. The white patches at base of primaries are obvious in flight. The male is a shiny blue-black on upperparts, head and upper breast, with mostly white below and bloodred eyes.
appearance.colors: The magpie starling (Speculipastor bicolor) is a member of the starling family from eastern Africa. The white patches at base of primaries are obvious in flight.

juvenile.notes: The Juvenile is brown with a white belly; eyes brown, becoming orange-red in as the bird matures. Exceptional young birds are entirely white below, including chin and throat.

where_found.habitat: It is a gregarious nomadic pied starling of dry brush and thorn-scrub in northern and eastern Kenya. It is also found in Ethiopia, Somalia, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Uganda.
